[...] FWD.us analysis shows that many TPS holders have been in the United States for a very long time, having set down roots, pursuing careers, building families, and integrating into American communities and society. In fact, TPS holders from El Salvador and Honduras, who make up a significant share of the current TPS population, have lived in the U.S. for more than 20 years on average. FWD.us estimates that more than 410,000 U.S. citizen adults live in households with at least one current TPS [...] Only people who have been continuously present in the United States since the date of designation (or re-designation) and who timely register with the government are eligible. Anyone who arrives after the date of designation cannot enroll, precluding any sort of incentive for further immigration. In addition, in order to avail oneself of a country’s temporary extension, current TPS holders must re-register with the government and again pay a significant filing fee for work authorization.

results.title: 2026 All-Star Game Season Ticket Holder Information | Philadelphia Phillies
results.content:
Any current full season ticket holder interested in adding seats to their account in advance of next season should contact their designated sales representative to discuss the possibility of adding additional tickets to their 2026 season ticket plan.
 All current partial season ticket holders will have their specific All-Star Week ticket opportunity determined based on the number of tickets on their account as of August 1, 2025. [...] Is there any other way for current season ticket holders to have the opportunity to purchase tickets to events during All-Star Week at Citizens Bank Park?

Current season ticket holders may also register for the general public All-Star Week ticket opportunity. Please note there will be limited tickets available in the general public All-Star Week ticket opportunity compared to the exclusive partial season account ticket opportunity drawing for 2023-2026 tenured partial season accounts. [...] The Phillies will not allow current season ticket holders to split up tickets across multiple accounts to secure additional All-Star Week ticket inventory. Restricting the splitting of accounts will allow the Phillies to offer as many current season ticket holders access to All-Star Week events tickets as possible.

results.title: Resources for Temporary Protected Status Holders - Ayanna Pressley
results.content:
If you are currently a TPS holder from Haiti or Syria, consult an immigration attorney as soon as possible. Local Haitian-serving community organizations offer free educational sessions and legal consultations, which are particularly helpful for individuals with pathways to permanent residency: [...] The Massachusetts Office for Refugees and Immigrants (ORI) Free Immigration Legal Helpdesk offers free legal advice to current or former TPS holders. For more, email ori-helpdesk@mass.gov.
 The Massachusetts Access to Counsel Initiative (MACI) provides comprehensive pro bono legal representation for individuals at risk of detention or currently detained by ICE. For more, visit:  or call (508) 505-4588. [...] This impacts the 45,000 TPS holders currently living in Massachusetts and endangers the lives and livelihoods of 1.3 million people from 17 countries currently protected by TPS across the United States.

Earlier this year, Congresswoman Pressley led the successful effort to pass H.R. 1689 in the U.S. House of Representatives. This bill would designate TPS for Haiti. Currently, the companion bill is in the Senate (S.4814, introduced by MA Senator Ed Markey).

results.title: January 1, 2027 California Law Will Extend CCW License Term • County of Humboldt
results.content:
“This change will reduce the frequency of renewals for thousands of CCW holders across California while also reducing some of the administrative workload associated with processing renewals,” Sheriff William Honsal said. “It is important for our current permit holders to understand that their existing permits are not automatically extended. They should continue to follow the expiration date on their current license and renew it as required.” [...] Current CCW license holders do not need to take any immediate action. Licenses issued before January 1, 2027, will remain valid until the 2-year expiration date printed on the license and will not automatically be extended. Once an existing license is renewed on or after January 1, 2027, the renewed license will be issued under the new three-year term. [...] CCW holders are encouraged to check the expiration date on their current license and continue following the existing renewal process until the new law takes effect.

For additional information regarding Humboldt County CCW licensing, please visit the Humboldt County Sheriff’s Office website humboldtsheriff.org or contact the Sheriff’s Office CCW Unit at (707) 268-3619.
